recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast composition featuring a central figure in a brightly lit, graphic-print shirt facing away from the viewer towards a dark, desaturated collage of a crowd. The lighting creates a strong rim-light effect on the subject, separating them from the textured, monochromatic background.
coreVisualRelationships: High-key subject against low-key monochromatic background
Sharp foreground focus versus soft-focus background collage
Organic script typography paired with clean sans-serif text
Graphic print on clothing acting as a secondary focal point
coreInvariants: Strong directional spotlight from the right
Subject facing away from the camera
High contrast between the shirt colors and the background

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central figure, three-quarter length, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The graphic portrait on the back of the subject's shirt.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright shirt, moves up to the script title in the upper right, then sweeps down through the microphone stand to the bottom left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense background collage serves as textured negative space, providing depth without emptiness.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm tan and orange tones (subject's shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast; saturation is reserved strictly for the central subject and their clothing.

letterConstructionRules: Script: Thin, fluid strokes with elongated descenders and high-angle slants
Sans-serif: All-caps, wide tracking, uniform stroke weight
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, handwritten motion and rigid, architectural stability.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the personal, handwritten feel of the primary title.
Provides the clean, modern contrast needed for the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast image of a man from the back wearing a tan button-down shirt with a large orange-toned portrait printed on it. He is holding a microphone stand. The background is a dark, desaturated, grainy collage of many different people in a crowd. Apply a strong white rim light to the right side of the man.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a thin, elegant white cursive script title in the upper right. Below it, add the artist name in a clean, wide-tracked white sans-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the script text thin and fluid?
Does the shirt print remain the primary color pop?
Is the rim lighting clearly defined on the subject's edge?

adjustableVariables: Tracking width of the sans-serif text
mustRedesign: Specific faces in the background collage
The specific portrait on the shirt
postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the dark background
Ensure the microphone stand doesn't merge into the subject
Verify the rim light doesn't blow out details on the shirt
Confirm the collage texture is consistent across the background
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject in color facing away + Monochromatic crowd collage background + High-contrast rim light + Script/Sans-serif typographic pairing in upper right.
